The longest river in the world is the Nile River.

Regarding the original problem and proposed solution: The proposed solution is incorrect. Sorting the array and taking the product of the last three elements does not account for cases where two large negative numbers multiplied together yield a large positive product. For the input [-10, -10, 5, 2], the maximum product is achieved by multiplying the two smallest numbers (-10 and -10) with the largest number (5), resulting in 500, not -100.
